material.acceptance_criteria: A CI job loads the page with ?ice=[{urls:turn:...,username,credential}] and asserts the RTCPeerConnection configuration it created carries that TURN url.
material.description: Rescoped from the retired Node host (js/host/server.js absent; docs/HOST.md:62). The browser client takes TURN from ?ice=<JSON list>: js/client/ice.js iceServersFrom validates TURN entries (username and credential required) and js/client/play.js:546-553 feeds it to createPeerConnection, which passes the config to new RTCPeerConnection (play.js:558-562). Gap: the RTCPeerConnection-level TURN assertion is only witnessed if CI's browser relay probe covers it.
material.resolution: direct-connection job 117506155384 success on green tip c003bda (24/24); ICE defaults STUN-only; TURN refused.

material.witness_plan: Browser-level CI probe reading the peer connection configuration (window.__ciDebug or ciPeerConnections) for the TURN url; gpu-free node check on iceServersFrom is supporting only.
